meta.title: Dust storm on Mars

moments.what: Haisheng declares a dust_storm expected in 16 s

title.en: A dust storm reaches the Mars base.
title.pt: Uma tempestade de poeira chega à base em Marte.

lines.en: Four crew are inside. One of them sees it coming.
lines.pt: Quatro tripulantes estão lá dentro. Um deles a vê chegando.

notes: Simulated scenario, recorded from the real hub in demo mode: every message is what the hub sent a shared screen.
The crew, their bodies and readings are the demo hub's simulated data. No sensor detected the event: a crewmate declared it.
Thinned for size: each signal of each room and person is kept at most once every 15 seconds, a replayed value also whenever it changes; evidence cards only when they change. Clock ticks are left out.

cardViews.title: Dust storm
steps: Rinse your eyes with saline, slowly, for several minutes.
Take off clothes or suit with dust before going to the common area.
Breathe calmly. If you cough or have trouble breathing, follow the lung card.
If the cough or trouble breathing lasts more than 30 minutes, tell the medical officer.
doNot: Do not shake out dusty clothes inside the common area.
unverified: All steps written from memory and adjusted by the medical lead; no source for any step.
Shelter, head count and closing hatches are base operations, not part of this card.

report.summary: Incident report: Dust storm, level 3, declared, crew told.
